cards.front: Pásame el mando de la tele, por favor. Gracias.
cards.back: Pass me the remote, please. Ta.

cards.front: ¿Le podrías pasar la sal a Susan? Gracias.
cards.back: Could you pass the salt to Susan? Cheers.

cards.front: ¿Me podrías pasar el chocolate? Gracias.
cards.back: Could you pass the chocolate? Thanks.

cards.front: ¿Me podrías pasar la sal? Gracias.
cards.back: Could you pass over the salt? Cheers.

cards.back: Excuse me, could you pass over the chocolate, please? Ta.

cards.front: Oye, ¿me podrías pasar el mando de la tele? Gracias.
cards.back: Hey, could you pass over the remote? Thanks.

cards.front: ¿De quién es esa botella? Pásamela, ¿quieres?
cards.back: Whose bottle is that? Pass it over here, would you?

cards.front: ¿De quién son esas gafas? Pásamelas, ¿quieres?
cards.back: Whose glasses are those? Pass them over here, would you?

cards.front: ¿De quién son esos guantes? Pásamelos, ¿quieres?
cards.back: Whose gloves are those? Pass them over here, would you?

cards.front: ¿Es ése el libro de Sanjay? Pásamelo un segundo.
cards.back: Is that Sanjay's book? Pass it here a sec.

cards.front: ¿Son ésas las gafas de Danny? Pásamelas un segundo.
cards.back: Are those Danny's glasses? Pass them here a sec.

cards.front: ¿Son esos los guantes de Craig? Pásamelos un segundo.
cards.back: Are those Craig's gloves? Pass them here a sec.

cards.front: ¡Él nunca me pasa el mando de la tele cuando se lo pido!
cards.back: He never passes the remote when I ask him for it!

cards.front: ¡Ella nunca me pasa la sal cuando se lo pido!
cards.back: She never passes me the salt when I ask her for it!

cards.front: Nunca le paso a él mi mechero cuando me lo pide.
cards.back: I never pass him my lighter when he asks me for it.

cards.front: Si no apruebo este examen, ¡mis padres me matarán!
cards.back: If I don't pass this exam, my parents will kill me!

cards.front: Si no aprobamos el examen, tendremos que repetir el curso.
cards.back: If we don't pass this exam, we'll have to repeat the year.

cards.front: Si no apruebo este examen, tendré que volver a presentarme.
cards.back: If I don't pass this exam, I'll have to re-sit it.

cards.front: Me está costando aprobar este examen.
cards.back: I'm finding it difficult to pass this exam.

cards.front: Me está costando aprobar este examen. ¡No quiero repetir curso!
cards.back: I'm finding it difficult to pass this exam. I don't want to repeat the year!

cards.front: Me está costando aprobar el examen. No quiero volver a presentarme.
cards.back: I'm finding it difficult to pass this exam. I don't want to re-sit it.

cards.front: La gente casi nunca aprueba este examen a la primera.
cards.back: People hardly ever pass this exam the first time.

cards.front: La gente que no estudia casi nunca aprueba este examen.
cards.back: People who don't study hardly ever pass this exam.

cards.front: Yo casi nunca apruebo los exámenes a la primera vez; suelo tener que volver a presentarme.
cards.back: I hardly ever pass exams the first time; I usually have to re-sit them.

cards.front: Voy a hacer todo lo posible por aprobar este examen.
cards.back: I'm going to do whatever it takes to pass this exam.

cards.front: Voy a hacer todo lo posible por aprobar el examen; no quiero repetir el curso.
cards.back: I'm going to do whatever it takes to pass the exam; I don't want to repeat the course.

cards.front: Tienes que hacer todo lo posible por aprobar el examen.
cards.back: You have to do whatever it takes to pass the exam.

cards.back: If I don't pass this exam, I'll cry. I don't want to do a re-sit.

cards.front: Tienes que hacer todo lo posible para aprobar.
cards.back: You have to do whatever it takes to pass.

cards.front: La gente que no estudia casi nunca aprueba.
cards.back: People who don't study hardly ever pass.

cards.front: Me está costando aprobar este examen. (Repaso)
cards.back: I'm finding it difficult to pass this exam.

cards.front: ¡Él no me deja adelantarle!

cards.front: ¡El tipo de delante no me deja adelantarle!

cards.front: Paso por delante de la fábrica de camino al trabajo. (My way)

cards.front: Pasamos por delante de una casita de campo preciosa antes.

cards.back: I passed a church on the way here.

cards.front: Tenemos que atravesar el túnel para llegar a Dover.
cards.back: We need to pass through the tunnel to get to Dover.

cards.back: I pass through a tunnel on the way to work.

cards.back: We'll have to pass through the valley on foot.

cards.front: ¿Cuánto se tarda en atravesar las montañas?
cards.back: How long does it take to pass through the mountains?

cards.front: Se tarda unos diez minutos en atravesar el túnel.
cards.back: It takes about ten minutes to pass through the tunnel.

cards.front: Se tarda media hora más o menos en atravesar el valle en coche.
cards.back: It takes about half an hour to pass through the valley by car.

cards.front: Se tarda unas dos horas en atravesar las montañas.
cards.back: It takes about two hours to pass through the mountains.

cards.back: How long does it normally take to pass through Andorra?

cards.back: How long does it normally take to pass through the town?

cards.back: It usually takes about half an hour to pass through Andorra.

cards.back: It usually takes about half an hour to pass through the town.
